question.worked_solution:
The given repeating decimal can be written as 

$$
\begin{aligned}7.8\overset{―}{7} & =7.877\,7... \\  & =7.8+0.07+0.007+0.000\,7+… \\  & =7.8+(\frac{7}{100}+\frac{7}{1\,000}+\frac{7}{10\,000}+…).\end{aligned}
$$

The series in the parentheses is a geometric series with first term ${a}_{1}=\frac{7}{100}$ and common ratio $r=\frac{1}{10}.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}7.8\overset{―}{7} & =7.8+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{1}{r}^{n-1} \\  & =7.8+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{7}{100}{(\frac{1}{10})}^{n-1} \\  & =7.8+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{7\cdot 10}{100}{(\frac{1}{10})}^{n} \\  & =7.8+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{7}{10}{(\frac{1}{10})}^{n}.\end{aligned}
$$
